command: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONPATH=src python -m pytest -q -o junit_family=legacy tests/test_*conduction.py --junitxml=results.xml
reference: Wall areas 0.25 and 0.75 m², areal capacity 3 J/(m² K), cell-wall conductance 2 and film coefficient 4 in W/(m² K). Cell temperatures start at 305 K and rise at 1 K/s through 0.125 s, then fall at 2 K/s. Walls remain 0.5 K warmer; material heat equals area times interval duration, storage equals 3 times area times temperature change, and the specified ambient imposes their sum. Compare each channel separately over [0,0.25] and [0.25,0.5] s under CN and Rannacher. Secondary mixed-face test verifies storage closure with second-order wall flux.
